comparison.objective: Match generator speed and phase, then close its breaker at the correct moment.
comparison.physical_skill: Read an instrument, actuate speed buttons iteratively, and time a final button press.
comparison.success_condition: Speed matched and first CLOSE press occurs within the specified phase window.
comparison.reason: Both involve iterative response observation, but this tests instrument-guided button timing and synchronization; the candidate uniquely tests physical tool engagement, collar rotation, lock torque, and impact mechanics.
